title: Dental PPO Plans Allowance Basis for Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
Under the Dental PPO Plans, the allowance a line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line) is figured on follows the billed procedure, and so decides the patient share on such a line.

| Line | Figured on |
|---|---|
| A posterior composite filling on a plan with the posterior composite alternate benefit, or a porcelain or ceramic crown (CDT D2740, D2750, D2751, D2752 or D2783) on a molar (teeth 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 30, 31 and 32) on a plan with the molar crown alternate benefit, whose billed amount is not below its alternate allowance | Its alternate allowance |
| Any line whose billed amount is below the allowance that would otherwise apply (the alternate allowance for such a filling or crown, the allowed amount otherwise) | Its billed amount |
| Every remaining line | Its allowed amount |

Plans with the posterior composite alternate benefit: Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250, Plus 1500. Plans with the molar crown alternate benefit: Classic 1250, Plus 1500. Premier 2000 and Elite 2500 have neither.

### Examples (hypothetical)
- Ceramic crown D2783 on tooth 3, Classic 1250, billed 1095.00, alternate allowance 702.15: figured on 702.15.
- The same crown on Elite 2500, billed 1095.00, allowed 918.40: figured on 918.40.
- Porcelain crown D2740 on tooth 14, Plus 1500, billed 655.00, alternate allowance 702.15: billed below the alternate allowance, figured on 655.00.
